title.narrative: Equipment for Modernisation of the Dosimetric Control System in the Exclusion Zone and Environmental (Radiation) Monitoring at the ''Vektor'' Complex and the Buriakivka Disposal Facility - U4.01/18B

description.narrative: Two important components of the radioactive waste management infrastructure within the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone are the Vektor complex and Buriakivka disposal facility. According to the Ukrainian regulations in force, the environment within and around these facilities must be monitored for radiation. The currently used monitoring equipment is obsolete and inadequate and needs to be replaced.
